title: SharePoint Graph Module - extend functionality with additional methods
summary: The SharePoint Graph module gains update and rename operations for drive items and list items via MS Graph PATCH endpoints, plus enhanced test infrastructure for multi-step operations.
key_points: Added UpdateDriveItem, RenameDriveItem, and UpdateDriveItemByPath methods for file operations
Added UpdateListItem and GetListItem methods for list item metadata management
Upgraded test handler to support multi-step HTTP operations beyond single-response mode
All changes are additive with no breaking changes to existing functionality
Includes 22 new tests covering drive item updates, list item operations, and handler infrastructure
quote: adding update operations for both drive items and list items, backed by the standard MS Graph PATCH endpoints
